briefdescription.para: Standalone inverted index for full-text search.

detaileddescription.para: Provides tokenisation, BM25-scored search, exact phrase search, and fuzzy (Levenshtein) search over a RocksDB backend.

Key schema (compatible with SecondaryIndexManager fulltext keys): ftidxmeta:<column> – index configuration (JSON) ftidx:<column>:<token>:<pk> – posting entry fttf:<column>:<token>:<pk> – term frequency (uint32 as string) ftdlen:<column>:<pk> – document length (uint32 as string)
Thread-safety: a single InvertedIndex instance is not thread-safe. Use one instance per thread or guard with an external mutex.
